import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def find_max_repeated_substring_length(N, S):
    def check(length):
        seen = set()
        for i in range(N - length + 1):
            substring = S[i:i+length]
            if substring in seen:
                return True
            seen.add(substring)
        return False

    left, right = 0, N
    while left < right:
        mid = (left + right + 1) // 2
        if check(mid):
            left = mid
        else:
            right = mid - 1
    return left

data = input().split()
N = int(data[0])
S = data[1]
result = find_max_repeated_substring_length(N, S)
print(result)
